review.wirePersistenceRuntimeImpact: No wire-format, cryptography, message identity or persisted-layout change. Exact local Link admission precedes RTT proof timing. Resource owner windows retain original timestamps; only externally observed Resources receive a finite 180-second accounting allowance after the original protocol deadline. Cancellation-aware adapters close and drain unpublished receipts while legacy sender installation retains its previous behavior. Exact cleanup is bounded and cannot erase replacement Links or lose uncancelled queued messages; authenticated settlement remains owned after Link closure. Optional reverse Resource completion hands off the single owned payload before conclusion cleanup, without changing legacy consumers. Authenticated no-compression announcements can now disable compression for unconstructed Direct Resources and queued payloads. Constructed Resources, split plans and propagation envelopes stay immutable; no wire fields or signatures change.
